title: Choose VEEMAP's visual world
question: Which world should shape the homepage? Lock one, steer the hand, or re-roll.

options.label: The Cycle Ledger
options.lineage: machine-builder kinematic sequence charts and line-cycle timing diagrams
options.thesis: Scroll becomes one complete machine cycle, proving how VEEMAP combines mechanisms, controls, vision, and data into speed.
options.viewport: A non-proprietary pick-and-place machine spans two-thirds of the fold at mid-cycle; a vertical 0-2.5 s timing ledger drives it while the proposition and requirements CTA lock into a fixed rail.
options.risk: Dense telemetry could bury the special-purpose-machine story unless only one cycle phase is active at a time.

raised.raise: The timing ledger now owns the viewport edge to edge instead of sitting inside a polite hero shell.
Every scroll threshold is staged as a decisive commissioned state change.
Motion is edited frame-exactly around the machine cycle rather than scattered as decoration.
Live, held, disabled, selected, and alert states remain legible without relying on colour alone.

options.label: The Metrology Dossier
options.lineage: CMM inspection reports, first-article certificates, and optical metrology screens
options.thesis: VEEMAP's story arrives as measured evidence: every claim is tied to a mechanism, tolerance, cycle, or verified result.
options.viewport: A precise 3D mechanism floats over a coordinate field with three decisive tolerance callouts; one evidence rail leads directly to Start a requirement review.
options.risk: The most immediately credible direction may over-emphasize inspection and underplay speed, invention, and complete-machine thinking.

options.label: Exploded Build Sequence
options.thesis: Every capability appears as the next module in a special-purpose machine being assembled on scroll.
options.viewport: Step 01 fills the fold: an exploded non-proprietary pick-and-place cell, one highlighted new subassembly, a 1:1 part callout, and a requirements action in the instruction legend.
options.case: It matches VEEMAP's modular engineering and makes complex mechanisms exceptionally clear; it loses audience identification when the assembly language feels toy-like.
options.risk: Without industrial material realism and disciplined scale, the machine could feel educational rather than premium and production-proven.

options.label: The Cycle Counter
options.lineage: seven-segment machine displays, scoreboards, and production counters
options.thesis: The homepage behaves like a live machine display in which every metric and state is illuminated only when it matters.
options.viewport: A monumental 170 PPM display shares the fold with a machine silhouette and a compact systems board; Tell us your target is the one illuminated control.
options.case: It identifies instantly with production equipment and makes performance memorable; it cannot explain VEEMAP's custom mechanisms as clearly as the assigned direction.
options.risk: A display-only language can become nostalgic, restrictive, or indistinguishable from a generic monitoring dashboard.

options.label: Certified Signal Stack
options.thesis: Machine codes, warnings, registration marks, and certification stamps form a deliberately dense engineering identity.
options.viewport: A shouting machine code cuts through layered warnings and process marks around one product silhouette.
options.case: It loses both audience identification and product clarity because hostile branding noise reads less precise than VEEMAP's engineering actually is.
options.risk: The brand can look adversarial and trend-led rather than accurate, fast, and trustworthy.

options.label: Commissioning Premiere
options.lineage: Art Deco cinema lobbies at premiere hour
options.thesis: Every commissioned machine arrives like a feature presentation through staged metallic thresholds.
options.viewport: A symmetrical machine silhouette is revealed behind a stepped brass threshold with the enquiry as the premiere action.
options.case: It loses both axes because theatrical luxury is not the visual culture of machine buyers and does not explain VEEMAP's mechanism.
options.kept: Decisive staged thresholds between operating states.
options.risk: Premium becomes ceremonial and ornamental instead of engineered.

options.label: High-Speed Contact Sheet
options.thesis: A machine cycle is inspected frame by frame as speed, light, and mechanism pass through one visual strip.
options.viewport: A horizontal strip isolates successive moments of pick, inspect, place, and confirm around one active frame.
options.case: It loses both axes because chemical wear suggests documentary nostalgia rather than modern industrial precision.
options.kept: Frame-exact temporal editing around the true machine cycle.
options.risk: The film artifact can romanticize production and weaken technical legibility.

options.label: Signal Path Schedule
options.thesis: Every sensor, mechanism, HMI, and health alert is connected by a traceable state-bearing signal path.
options.viewport: A large machine is indexed by numbered signal lanes whose link patterns expose live, held, disabled, and alert states.
options.case: It identifies with controls specialists but loses product clarity for plant leaders and procurement visitors who need the whole machine story first.
options.kept: State semantics that do not depend on colour alone.
options.risk: The page can become a specialist wiring interface rather than a persuasive company homepage.

canonCard.label: Premium Industrial Integrator
canonCard.thesis: The established automation-company pattern executed at full craft: factory cinema, proof metrics, capability cards, and a direct enquiry.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed factory video carries the company proposition, proof counters, and one orange enquiry action above a familiar capability grid.
canonCard.risk: Professionally credible but intentionally difficult to distinguish from other premium industrial-automation firms.
